---
pagetitle: "Friends capstone"
title: "Friends capstone"
description: >-
  Lokakynning mánudaginn 16. nóvember: lyfturæður allra teyma.
lang: is
format:
  revealjs:
    theme:
      - white
      - ../styles/hi.scss
    css: ../styles/watermark.css
    logo: ../img/hi/hi_named_logo-is.svg
    footer: "IÐN302G · Upplýsingaverkfræði · Haust 2026"
    title-slide: false
    title-slide-attributes:
      data-visibility: hidden
    hash: true
    controls: true
    controls-layout: edges
    controls-back-arrows: visible
    slide-number: true
    progress: true
    chalkboard: false
    preview-links: auto
    width: 1280
    height: 720
    margin: 0.04
    transition: none
    background-transition: none
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        <link rel="icon" type="image/svg+xml" href="../img/hi/favicon.svg">
        <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.7.2/css/all.min.css" crossorigin="anonymous" referrerpolicy="no-referrer">
        <style>
        .reveal .slide-logo { right: 78px !important; }
        .reveal .slide-number {
          position: fixed !important;
          top: auto !important;
          bottom: 0 !important;
          right: 10px !important;
          height: var(--footer-height) !important;
          display: flex !important;
          align-items: center;
          justify-content: center;
          gap: 3px;
          padding: 0 4px !important;
          background: transparent !important;
          color: var(--footer-text) !important;
          font-family: inherit;
          font-size: 14px !important;
          z-index: 110 !important;
        }
        .reveal .slide-number a { color: inherit !important; }
        .reveal a,
        .reveal a:hover,
        .reveal a:focus-visible {
          color: var(--blue) !important;
          text-decoration-color: var(--blue) !important;
        }
        .reveal .toc-map {
          display: grid;
          grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
          gap: 12px 20px;
          margin-top: 24px;
        }
        .reveal a.toc-stop {
          display: flex;
          align-items: center;
          gap: 18px;
          min-height: 88px;
          padding: 12px 18px;
          box-sizing: border-box;
          border: 1px solid var(--panel);
          background: var(--white);
          color: var(--blue);
          text-decoration: none;
          text-align: left;
          transition: background 120ms ease;
        }
        .reveal a.toc-stop:hover,
        .reveal a.toc-stop:focus-visible {
          background: var(--soft-blue-bg);
          outline: 2px solid var(--blue);
          outline-offset: 2px;
        }
        .reveal .toc-number {
          display: grid;
          place-items: center;
          flex: 0 0 46px;
          height: 46px;
          background: var(--teal);
          font-size: 23px;
          font-weight: 900;
        }
        .reveal .toc-label { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
        .reveal .toc-label strong { display: block; font-size: 22px; line-height: 1.2; }
        .reveal .toc-label > span { display: block; margin-top: 5px; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.25; color: var(--ink); }
        .reveal .toc-arrow { font-size: 25px; }
        #gagnasagan .fa-card-icon .box-icon,
        #kynning .fa-card-icon .box-icon { color: var(--white); }
        #skyrslan > h3 { margin-top: 22px; }
        .reveal .fc-logo { position:absolute; right:130px; top:150px; width:330px; height:341px; }
        .reveal .fc-logo svg { width:100%; height:100%; display:block; }
        .reveal .vid { display:flex; justify-content:center; margin-top:8px; }
        .reveal .vid iframe { width:304px; height:540px; border:0; }
        .reveal .when { color: var(--blue); font-weight:700; margin:0; }
        </style>
    include-after-body:
      text: |
        <script>
        (function () {
          const BASE = "Upplýsingaverkfræði";
          function currentName() {
            if (!window.Reveal || !Reveal.getCurrentSlide) return "";
            const slide = Reveal.getCurrentSlide();
            if (!slide) return "";
            const heading = slide.querySelector("h1, h2, h3");
            return heading ? heading.textContent.trim() : "";
          }
          function updateTitle() {
            const name = currentName();
            document.title = name ? BASE + " – " + name : BASE;
          }
          let tries = 0;
          const MAX_TRIES = 50;
          function init() {
            if (window.Reveal && Reveal.on) {
              Reveal.on("ready", updateTitle);
              Reveal.on("slidechanged", updateTitle);
              updateTitle();
            } else if (tries++ < MAX_TRIES) {
              setTimeout(init, 200);
            }
          }
          init();
        })();
        </script>
